judgment: It is good to ford the great river.
It is good to hold firm.
image: Wind over the marsh: Central Trust.
So the noble one weighs lawsuits
lines: Anything else, and he has no rest.
A crane cries in the shade,
I have a good cup of wine —
I will share it with you.
now he drums, now he stops,
now he weeps, now he sings.
One of his team-horses is lost,

notes.name_en: 中孚 trust (孚) held at the centre; 'Central Trust', never Wilhelm's 'Inner Truth' (banned signature).
notes.judgment: 豚魚 pigs and fish — humble offerings trust still reaches; kept as the creatures.
notes.L6: 翰音 a fowl's cry flying up: sound rising empty to heaven.
